```
## Latest handoff

**From:** {name}, round {round}

**What I did:** short list of concrete changes (files and reasons).

**Decisions and why:** decisions made and their reasons.

**Open objections:** remaining discussion (with #numbers where available).

**Recommended next step:** the most valuable action for the next agent.
```

{request}{interventions}

{previous}

## HANDOFF: read this first
The full handoff is in `HANDOFF.md`. Open it to rewrite “Latest handoff” (or the existing “Último traspaso” section); preserve the status block.

## Changes since your last turn
{changes}
{partial}## Discussion: objections you must answer
{pending}

## Your work
1. Start from this brief. Open a file only to change or cite it; verify reported changes on disk.
2. Answer every pending objection using the format above.
3. In `HANDOFF.md`, replace the handoff section with:
{handoffFormat}
4. Update `MEMORIA.md` (decisions, preferences, status, remaining work). Add reusable lessons to

brief.prefix:
# Turn in OfficeMatrix

{staff}You are **{name}** ({role}). You work in an office with {colleagues}: {order}.
You take turns on the SAME project, the current folder.
{mode}
Do not close while there are open or disputed objections from the next agent in the cycle or the user.
If the average score changes by less than 0.5 between two complete rounds (plateau), or drops by at least 0.5 (regression), the cycle stops **without approval**. Cosmetic changes do not rescue a round; fix what lowers the score.

<!-- PREFIJO ESTABLE -->
Fixed rules:
1. This document is the context package. `.office/contexto.md` is the same copy: do not open it again. Open a project file only to change or cite it.
2. If the request is unresolved, fix the files and explain why. Do not silently undo a colleague’s work: object or reply.
3. Do not touch `.office/` or leave this project folder.
4. Keep the project tidy: `README.md` at the root; plans in `docs/`; code in `src/` or the language’s natural structure; tests in `tests/`; texts in `contenido/`, one file per piece.
5. Your final response MUST end with the protocol block.

{protocol}
- `SCORE`: your honest assessment against the request, AFTER your changes. Approval requires at least {minScore}/10.
- `VERDICT: APPROVED` only if you made NO work changes, raise no new objections and score at least {minScore}. Otherwise use `VERDICT: CHANGES`.
  (Updates to MEMORIA.md, HANDOFF.md, shared memory or docs/DISCUSION.md do not count as work changes. OfficeMatrix checks the files you touched.)
{doneRule}{template}
brief.protocol:
```
OBJECTIONS:
- one specific objection per line, with a reason (or "- none")
REPLIES:
- #N RESOLVED|REJECTED|AGREED|WITHDRAWN|MAINTAINED: your argument (one per pending objection; "- none" if none)
SCORE: X/10
VERDICT: APPROVED or CHANGES{done}
```

brief.ruleApproval: SCORE assesses `final/`. APPROVED requires at least {minScore} and no objections; otherwise use CHANGES and specific objections.
brief.ruleDraft: SCORE assesses your draft; use VERDICT: CHANGES.
brief.ruleEvaluate: SCORES: one line per draft. SCORE is their average; use VERDICT: CHANGES.
brief.ruleReview: SCORE assesses draft {letter} as received, before edits. APPROVED only with no changes (except the review section) and score at least {minScore}; use CHANGES if you improved it.
brief.ruleSynthesis: SCORE assesses the final version; use VERDICT: CHANGES because you just wrote it.

- A: X/10 one line explaining why

workflow.consejo.careful: the chair has the final say; choose the strongest writer for this task.
workflow.consejo.explain: The AIs propose independently at the same time, then anonymously read and score their colleagues’ drafts. Your chosen chair combines the best ideas into a final version, which the others approve or request changes to.
workflow.consejo.ideal: posts, scripts, hooks, titles and blog articles where you want one result with the best of every AI.
workflow.consejo.name: Council
workflow.consejo.tagline: everyone proposes and scores; a chair writes the final version
workflow.delphi.careful: produces several good versions (the best goes in final/) and uses more subscription quota because several agents work at once.
workflow.delphi.explain: The AIs start independently at the same time, without seeing the others. They rotate drafts, improve a colleague’s work anonymously and score it. The highest scoring draft is copied to final/.
workflow.delphi.ideal: research, fact checking, news, science articles and comparing different ideas.
workflow.delphi.name: Parallel + rotation
workflow.delphi.tagline: everyone contributes, then reviews one another
workflow.relevo.careful: the first AI sets the direction and the others tend to follow it. Choose the starting agent and team order in settings.
workflow.relevo.explain: The AIs work one after another. The first does the work and passes it to the next, which reviews and improves it. They continue until everyone approves.
workflow.relevo.ideal: code, apps, websites and any shared project that everyone edits.

om.help:
om — OfficeMatrix for agents

  node om.js office                          your office: name, AI team, missions
  node om.js missions                        the office's missions (running first)
  node om.js new "request" [options]         starts a mission and prints its id
      --mode relay|delphi|council            relay (one after another, code), delphi (each AI writes its own version,
                                             then they review: unbiased research), council (everyone proposes and a
                                             chair synthesizes: strategy, plans)              [default: delphi]
      --team claude,codex                    AIs that work (only those allowed in the office)
      --rounds N                             review rounds (1-20)                             [default: 2]
      --auto                                 let the AIs decide when it is done (capped at --rounds)
      --score N                              minimum score to approve (1-10)                  [default: 9]
      --parallel N                           AIs working at once in delphi/council            [default: 1]
      --chair ID                             who synthesizes in council
      --attach path                          file for everyone to read (repeatable; PDF, docx, xlsx, images…)
  node om.js status ID                       phase, round, who is working and what they are thinking
  node om.js wait ID [--max-min 240]         waits until it ends (checks every 30 s) and shows the result
  node om.js result ID [--download folder]   what was delivered and where; --download fetches the deliverables
  node om.js file ID path [dest]             downloads one file from the mission
  node om.js intervene ID "directive"        a mid-cycle instruction (read on their next turn)
  node om.js stop ID                         stops the cycle

  The Spanish commands (oficina, misiones, nueva, estado, esperar, resultado, archivo, intervenir, detener)
  and options (--modo, --equipo, --rondas, --nota, --a-la-vez, --presidente, --adjunto, --bajar) also work.
  Language: OM_LANG=en|es

  Environment: OM_URL={url}  OM_LLAVE={key}
